name: crowdin-action
description: This action allows you to manage and synchronize localization resources with your Crowdin project

upload_sources_args.description: Additional arguments which will be passed to the `upload sources` cli command

upload_language.description: Use this option to upload translations for a single specified language - Case-Sensitive

import_eq_suggestions.description: Defines whether to add translation if it is equal to source string in Crowdin project

upload_translations_args.description: Additional arguments which will be passed to the `upload translations` cli command

download_sources.description: Defines whether to download source files from the Crowdin project

push_sources.description: Push downloaded sources to the branch

download_sources_args.description: Additional arguments which will be passed to the `download sources` cli command

download_translations.description: Defines whether to download translation files from the Crowdin project

download_language.description: Use this option to download translations for a single specified language

download_bundle.description: Download bundle from Crowdin project (by ID)

skip_untranslated_strings.description: Skip untranslated strings in exported files (does not work with .docx, .html, .md and other document files)

skip_untranslated_files.description: Omit downloading not fully translated files

export_only_approved.description: Include approved translations only in exported files. If not combined with --skip-untranslated-strings option, strings without approval are fulfilled with the s

push_translations.description: Push downloaded translations to the branch

commit_message.default: New Crowdin translations by GitHub Action

localization_branch_name.description: To download translations to the specified version branch

create_pull_request.description: Create pull request after pushing to branch

pull_request_title.default: New Crowdin translations by GitHub Action
pull_request_title.description: The title of the new pull request

pull_request_body.description: The contents of the pull request

pull_request_assignees.description: Add up to 10 assignees to the created pull request (separated by comma)

pull_request_reviewers.description: Usernames of people from whom a review is requested for this pull request (separated by comma)

pull_request_team_reviewers.description: Team slugs from which a review is requested for this pull request (separated by comma)

pull_request_labels.description: To add labels for created pull request

pull_request_base_branch_name.description: Create pull request to specified branch instead of default one

download_translations_args.description: Additional arguments which will be passed to the `download translations` cli command

skip_ref_checkout.description: Skip default git checkout on GITHUB_REF

crowdin_branch_name.description: Option to upload or download files to the specified version branch in your Crowdin project

config.description: Option to specify a path to the configuration file, without / at the beginning

dryrun_action.description: Option to preview the list of managed files

user.description: Run the action as this user (uid:gid format, e.g. "1001:1001"). Use "auto" to detect from workspace ownership. Leave empty to run as root (default).

github_base_url.description: Option to configure the base URL of GitHub server, if using GHE.

github_api_base_url.description: Options to configure the base URL of GitHub server for API requests, if using GHE and different from api.github_base_url.

github_user_name.description: Option to configure GitHub user name on commits.

github_user_email.description: Option to configure GitHub user email on commits.

gpg_private_key.description: GPG private key in ASCII-armored format

token.description: Personal access token required for authentication

base_url.description: Base URL of Crowdin server for API requests execution

base_path.description: Path to your project directory on a local machine, without / at the beginning

source.description: Path to the source files, without / at the beginning

command_args.description: Additional arguments which will be passed to the Crowdin CLI command
